text:
katie: FYI heading into the EBR rehearsal: Meridian onboarding live demo is flaky in the shared sandbox. need a concrete fallback plan + slide update. who can pick this up?
ben: saw intermittent gateway 504s during two runs. looks like token auth timeout upstream. tagging infra.
samir: proposal: replace live start with a 90s recorded clip + a short guided walk-through using screenshots. keeps the exec flow but removes risk.
tosin: I can rework the demo slide and embed a clip. need the raw clip (or access to source recording) from eng. also can add a single slide with "if live fails" talking points.
katie: action assignments: @tosin = slides + clip embed; @ben = escalate infra and share status here; @samir = write a 45-60s spoken script for the clip and a 2-step interactive fallback script for the demo host. target: EOD Wednesday.
ben: quick debug snippet I ran: 
```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://staging.api.redwood.ai/demo/start 
# response: 504 (intermittent)
```
ben: opened infra ticket INC-1798, suspect gateway LB health check. ping @infra-oncall for triage.
samir: I'll draft the narration and a "sticky notes" style host script that the presenter can use if they have to switch to the recording mid-demo. will post by EOD Tue.
katie: also need a one-page runbook for the host with clear steps during the Q&A if something goes wrong. example checklist: 
```
- Attempt live demo start (30s).
- If demo start fails -> switch to 90s recorded clip (embed on slide).
- If clip not available -> show annotated screenshots + voiceover bullets.
- If asked about latency/SLAs -> point to Console > QBR > Meridian latency panel (slide 7).
- After QBR: open incident with infra ticket link, assign follow-up owner.
```
ben: uploading recording and raw assets to GDrive -> https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1MeridianDemoAssets
calendar-bot: Reminder: EBR rehearsal Thu 2026-04-02 16:00 UTC. RSVP if you're presenting.
tosin: got the assets, starting edits. will replace slide 4 with flow diagram + embedded clip.
katie: thanks. I'll own the runbook doc and finalize deck by Wed 10:00 PT. call out any blockers before EOD Tue.
jordan: I'll review the final deck from a commercial perspective; pls flag any asks for exec attention.
leila: I'll prepare the customer health snapshot and a short renewal-risk blurb for the execs.
infra-oncall: looking into INC-1798, can confirm LB health flaps correlated with a config push at 06:12 UTC. will update here with remediation ETA.
ben: thanks. tagging for rehearsal: @jordan @leila please be on the rehearsal so we can validate the fallback messaging.
katie: perfect 1 — keep updates in this thread and put final deck link here when ready. thanks team.
